argv:
import re,sys
s=open('Apps/ParticleUniverse/App/DeviceConditionsSource.swift').read()
reads=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'uitest', s)]
blocks=[(m.start(), s.index('#endif', m.start())) for m in re.finditer(r'#if DEBUG', s)]
outside=[r for r in reads if not any(a<r<b for a,b in blocks) and not s[:r].rsplit(chr(10),1)[-1].lstrip().startswith('//')]
print('uitest reads', len(reads), 'outside DEBUG (non-comment)', len(outside)); sys.exit(1 if outside else 0)
